# Questions — lexicographe (passe 1, balayage)

### Q1
Terms: atelier, STATION
Question: I read these as one same thing under two names — the French
domain word and the segment code. §2: « chacun suivi d'un atelier, dans
un ordre fixe — SkiErg, Sled Push, Sled Pull, Burpee Broad Jump,
Rameur, Farmers Carry, Sandbag Lunges, Wall Balls. » · §A.3:
« | `<Atelier> Out` | `STATION` du cycle n | ». Is STATION the name of
the segment that an atelier occupies, i.e. one thing, or are they two
distinct things (the exercise itself vs. the timed segment)?
Answer:

"piste" a thing of its own?
Answer:
